gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an overclaim that directional-motion results characterize tangent-space distributions and the timing of inter-mode probability. ISSUE-013 concerns an unquantified identification between two tangent projectors in a training-to-inference error bound; it does not diagnose the missing characterization or emergence-probability obligation.

The gold issue rejects an early experimental normal-distance interpretation because spectral separation is not reliable in the plotted regime. ISSUE-009 attacks frozen-frame geometric derivations of curvature and velocity; it does not identify the early plot, its stage interpretation, or the missing reliability threshold.

The gold issue is that the numerical estimator accepts normal-score zeros without checking the ridge curvature condition λ_{d*+1}≤−β. ISSUE-009 concerns a frozen versus moving frame in implicit geometric calculations and supplies no diagnosis of the estimator's missing curvature acceptance test.

The gold issue is the omitted derivative of E in the Newton Jacobian for F(y)=E(y)^T∇log p(y). ISSUE-009 identifies omitted frame derivatives in second-fundamental-form and normal-velocity arguments, which are different geometric operations and does not diagnose the Newton estimator's Jacobian.

The gold issue concerns applying the inverse of Λ_perp at unrestricted points without a nonzero-eigenvalue or conditioning safeguard. ISSUE-001 concerns failure of a global eigengap and undefined eigenframes at an isotropic point; an eigengap failure is not the same as the missing lower bound needed for the spectral inverse.
